private_notes.private_reasoning: Open with a substantial class recovery reflecting the $64 million in disputed charges, litigation risk, and the value of prompt payment. Keep distribution automatic and direct any unawarded fees to the class. Seek a separately paid fee subject to court review.

Fees should be separately stated but remain subject to court review, with any reduction benefiting the class.

declaration.negotiation_history_statement: As interim class counsel, Hargrove Lane LLP negotiated the class recovery and attorneys’ fees as parts of the same settlement discussions. Both sides made concessions before agreeing to a $29 million class fund and a separate $4 million fee-and-expense amount, subject to court approval. The parties agreed to automatic payments to identifiable class members, no clear-sailing provision, and payment to the class of any fees the Court declines to award. The settlement remains subject to the Court’s independent review, including review of the requested fee.
